name: two-speaker-stack-host-right
description: two-speaker-stack with the tiles flipped: the RIGHT-hand gallery tile goes on top, so a host sitting camera-right still leads the stack. Two source-specific fixes over the base preset. (1) Tiles are pinned, not brightness-detected: the guest's dark suit and the host's black studio backdrop drag both tiles under the detector's threshold, which mis-measured them on 35% of sampled frames. Measured geometry is two 955-wide halves either side of a 10px gutter at x=955-964. (2) The pinned tiles stop at y=976, just above the burned-in name pills (measured at y=977-1063 on both tiles), so a crop can never clip one; the base preset's sideways badge dodge cannot help here because these tiles are portrait, leaving no room to slide. face_height_frac is raised to 0.575 so the host's crop, which is large in his tile, still clears that limit without being clamped. Tuned on the Jake Claver / EezyXRPeezy XRP interview, Aug 2026.
